brief: ここは、ちゃんとリュックにして。
prompt: Edit the supplied reference image, replacing only the woven bamboo basket on the left with a worn, plain olive-brown canvas rucksack appropriate for rural Japan in 1988. The rucksack must be unmistakably a fabric backpack, with a flap closure, simple buckles, and two fabric shoulder straps, with no wicker or basket structure. Place it fallen on its side on the same wet rocks, occupying approximately the same position and size as the original basket, with its shoulder straps lying loosely across the stones. Match the existing side lighting, shadows, moisture, perspective, and photorealistic texture. Preserve the original wide, low-angle 16:9 composition and every other element: the scattered bamboo shoots, aluminium water bottle, beige towel trailing into the stream, small sickle, wet gravel, mossy rocks, flowing water, and fresh green vegetation. Maintain a dim but readable mountain stream scene in Yamagata, Japan, on a late-May night. No people, bears, blood, wounds, snow, text, subtitles, logos, or additional objects.
message: 指示した修正を反映しました。確認してください
